title: Injection-ratio laser noise transfer
scope: Complete injection ratio; one laser/resonator setup. Development validation blocks complete log-frequency bands across two ratios.
selection: Lowest whole-group OOF physical-unit MAE among substantive attempts; prefer fewer coefficients within1percent. Baselines retained even if superior. No test-based replacement.
stopping: At least five materially distinct attempts. Continue distinct evidence-led hypotheses; stop after two consecutive substantive attempts after the current best with no >=1percent MAE gain, >=5percent worst-group gain, or supported structural simplification.
confirmation: Separate process only after code/states/selection/stopping hashes frozen; all outcomes become exposed thereafter.
exposure: Public source-aware corpus; source plots and published analyses known. Schema previews exposed first rows only. Case30 speeds>=13.9mm/s previewed; scored0.28–10mm/s unviewed. Case22 initial~0.006V row previewed; targetV>=0.05V unviewed. Case65 10Hz first rows previewed; scoref>=100Hz. Reserved response distributions and scores unopened.
uncertainty: Per-group errors and ranges only; no dependent-row confidence interval. Very few top-level conditions constrain generalization.
calibration: No held-ratio calibration. Log10 target transform fixed; measuredPSD only and100<=f<=1e6Hz.
baselines: established physical or matched calibration baseline
constrained flexible model under same information
fit: Development-only group-balanced least squares; forcase65 equivalent least squares in decibels. Frozen transformations; parameter bounds recorded per candidate.
exclusions: Nonfinite native values excluded with anchors; none excluded by fit residuals. All source bytes unchanged.
